1. Проверка подключений и подготовка — р: 1. Connection checks and preparation are separate actions
При открытии страницы приложение проверя:
Opening this page checks SSH, agent, USB ADB and stock Web availability without signing in to HTTP services. Check connections also tests each entered Web and agent password once and reads device identification. Empty passwords are not sent. An unavailable service and a rejected password are shown separately. This check installs nothing and does not enable ADB. Connect automatically chooses SSH, then USB ADB; Web and agent are shown as access information. Preparation uses its own button and the stock Web and agent passwords. If SSH is already available, preliminary preparation is disabled unless Skip firmware check is selected. An unfinished preparation can resume with firmware checking enabled.

If SSH and the agent are not prepared, installation requires the stock Web interface and a USB data cable. The app blocks concurrent operations and checks for unfinished IMEI changes and full-image restores.
2. Вход в Web и свежая резервная копия: 2. Web sign-in and a fresh backup
Приложение обращается по HTTP к указанно:
The app connects by HTTP to the specified IPv4 address. It requests the zte_web_sault challenge through JSON-RPC /ubus/, computes SHA-256 of the password, then SHA-256 of that hash together with the challenge, and sends the resulting hash to web_login. The returned session and cookie are used for later requests.

After sign-in, it reads IMEI and external and internal firmware versions. The modem creates a fresh encrypted settings backup for download to the Mac. Web identity is checked again afterward, including when access is already prepared. The Web password is not placed in the archive or command line.
3. Проверка архива и включение ADB на B3: 3. Backup validation and enabling ADB on B31
На Mac архив расшифровывается ключом, со:
On the Mac, the backup is decrypted using the modem IMEI and the bundled Backup-key suffix. The app validates OpenSSL Salted__ format, gzip/tar structure, the inner archive MD5, and the contents and location of etc/rc.local. The archive is processed in memory.

Only etc/rc.local changes: the shown line is inserted immediately after #!/bin/sh. Other entries and metadata are compared with the original. After packing, MD5 is updated and the archive is encrypted, then decrypted again to verify it. back_parameter.original, identity.json and manifest.json are saved on the Mac; back_parameter.adb-only is also saved before upload. This is a settings backup, not a full storage image.

If verified SSH with agent or suitable ADB access already exists, the backup restore for ADB activation is skipped. If the activation line already exists, the app waits for ADB instead of uploading again.
4. Загрузка изменённого бэкапа — только: 4. Uploading a modified backup only when required
Этот путь разрешён для проверенного проф:
This route is allowed for the verified MU5250 B31 profile. The modified archive is sent to the stock CGI uploader at /tmp/back_parameter. Its response must include the exact SHA-256 of the uploaded file. Web device identity is checked again before uploading and before restoring.

The stock device_restore_proc then restores settings and reboots the modem. A restore-requested marker is saved on the Mac beforehand. If HTTP disconnects during reboot, the restore is not sent again; the app waits up to four minutes for ADB. Web activation is blocked if only a previously known CID is available without a verified link to the IMEI, preventing modification of another modem.
5. Выбор ADB-устройства и проверка проши: 5. ADB device selection and firmware checks
Встроенный adb перечисляет устройства. Д:
The bundled adb lists devices. Each candidate must provide root and aarch64. The app reads modem.b16 and diag-router SHA-256 hashes, eMMC CID and stock Web information through ubus. IMEI and firmware versions must match the backup source. Multiple matching devices stop installation.

The verified B31 profile is allowed by default. Skipping the general firmware check does not remove installer restrictions: only exact known B31 hashes or the separate experimental B02 profile are accepted. B02 requires already working root ADB over USB; backup restore is not used to enable ADB on B02. Prepared B02 access does not establish compatibility with IMEI changes.
На Mac создаётся или повторно использует:
The Mac creates or reuses an Ed25519 SSH key pair. The private key stays on the Mac with mode 600; only the public key is transferred. The server key is read through verified ADB, with CID checked before and after, and saved in a separate known_hosts file for the modem address and port 2222. Later SSH commands use StrictHostKeyChecking=yes.

After installation, ADB and SSH identities are compared. On B31, a helper reads both NV IMEIs and compares them with ubus; the agent process is verified through /proc/<pid>/exe. A new agent is tested with the configured password. B02 checks root, ARM64, firmware, identity, process and agent sign-in without NV writes.

Only then does the installer receive --commit, verify after.sha256 and mark the journal complete. The app saves SSH settings, connects and refreshes section data. Transferred temporary files are removed; private recovery snapshots remain.
Локальный setup-pending.json сохраняет у:
Local setup-pending.json stores the device and operation stage. A requested backup restore is not automatically repeated. If installation was already requested, the app reads the remote journal first. Automatic completion is allowed only from ready or complete after verifying SSH and device identity. Earlier unfinished stages are retained for investigation and recovery; an unknown state is neither reported as success nor overwritten by a fresh installation.

Preparation changes the listed access and settings files. It does not install tiles or modem localization, write IMEIs, remount /usr/zte_web read-write or flash ZTEDATA. The original Web archive and installation journal are stored under SetupBackups/<UUID> in the Mac app data. Actual commands and results are available in the activity log.
Запись выполняется по SSH от root с собс:
Writes use root SSH with the app key and strict known-server-key verification. Web, agent and ADB do not replace SSH for NV writes.

If SSH is not yet connected but Web and agent passwords are entered, the combined button first performs the preparation described beside the preliminary preparation button. On verified B31 it then reads the pair and continues if target IMEIs differ. Experimental B02 preparation does not automatically proceed to IMEI writing. Initial preparation may require another reboot to enable ADB.

Both IMEIs must be different 15-digit numbers with valid Luhn check digits, and the pair must differ from the current pair. Unfinished installation, IMEI operations or full-image restores block a new write.
2. Проверка устройства и чтение исходной: 2. Device verification and reading the original pair
The app checks eMMC CID, modem.b16 and diag-router hashes, and the current boot_id. Verified MU5250 B31 is allowed by default. Strict NV format, /config structure and device identity checks remain even when the general firmware check is skipped; that option does not establish compatibility with other firmware.

A local operation lock and remote /tmp/zte-imei-app.lock with an owner token are created. zte_nv reads NV550 indexes 0 and 1, each 128 bytes. A legacy NV550 read must exactly match index 0. Both decoded IMEIs are compared with the stock get_imei/get_imei2 API.
Для каждого вызова приложение сверяет вс:
For every call, the app verifies the bundled helper against helpers.json, creates a private /tmp/zte-imei-<UUID> directory and transfers the helper through SSH stdin using cat. It sets mode 700 and verifies SHA-256 on the modem. A required plan also arrives through stdin, is saved with mode 600 and checked by SHA-256. Afterward the app attempts to remove its temporary files and directory.

zte_nv, zte_config and zte_config_read use /usr/lib/libdiag.so.1, verify DIAG session ownership, replies and frame CRC, and release the session afterward. They do not accept arbitrary file paths or arbitrary write commands. This procedure does not separately stop or start the radio; connectivity is interrupted by reboots.
Помощник zte_config_read читает /config:
zte_config_read reads /config in the baseband EFS. This is a DIAG/EFS object, not a regular Linux /config file. It requires the exact B31 structure: 15,073 bytes, 249 records, valid header, footer and CRC, and a single config102 at its known position. Its original flag must be 0. NV is read again and must match the first snapshot.

The Mac saves full nv0.bin and nv1.bin, config.bin and manifest.json with SHA-256, IMEIs, CID and firmware hash. The backup is immediately reopened and verified. Only then is pending.json created with full target NV records, identity and the prepared stage.

New IMEIs replace only the first 9 bytes of each 128-byte NV record; the other 119 bytes remain unchanged. This targeted IMEI and EFS backup does not replace a full modem image.
5. Временное разрешение записи и первая: 5. Temporary write permission and the first reboot
Из исходного EFS config создаётся кандид:
A candidate EFS config changes the config102 flag at offset 499 from 0 to 1 and recalculates CRC in bytes 12–15. All other bytes remain unchanged. The helper plan contains exactly the original and candidate config.

zte_config opens /config read-only. To change it, the helper creates its own candidate and rollback files in EFS, verifies their complete contents and synchronization, then replaces /config using EFS RENAME14. It rechecks all bytes and synchronization afterward. Foreign temporary files or unknown contents block writing.

The app saves rebooting-to-enable and sends the stock reboot command once. It waits up to four minutes for SSH, a new boot_id and the same CID and firmware hash. SSH disconnection during reboot is expected; the command is not blindly repeated.
6. Последовательная запись двух индексов: 6. Sequential writes to both NV550 indexes
После загрузки повторно сверяются устрой:
After boot, the app rechecks the device, config and both NV records. Each record must match its known original or target. It creates a 512-byte plan containing current NV0, current NV1, target NV0 and target NV1, also saved locally as nv-plan.bin.

zte_nv --apply-plan rechecks the plan and initial state. It writes index 0 through indexed DIAG, then fully rereads both indexes and the legacy alias. Only an exact expected match permits writing index 1, followed by the same full checks. The app separately compares NV and both ubus results with the target IMEIs.

These are sequential, individually verified steps rather than an atomic two-slot write. On error, the helper attempts to restore known original records in reverse order and verifies the result. Unknown or unreadable data is not blindly replaced; rollback cannot be guaranteed after loss of power or connection.
7. Возврат config, вторая перезагрузка и: 7. Restoring config, second reboot and verification
После подтверждения целевой пары zte_con:
After confirming the target pair, zte_config restores the exact original EFS config from the backup, including its flag and CRC, using the same verified temporary-file, rename, readback and synchronization procedure.

The app saves final-reboot and the current boot_id, sends one reboot command and waits for a new boot_id from the same modem. It then rereads both NV records, checks IMEIs through the stock API and verifies config byte-for-byte against the original. Only full success creates completed.json and result.json and removes pending.json.

A normal new operation uses two reboots. On resume, completed stages are determined from the actual data and journal; disconnection alone does not trigger new writes.
При ошибке приложение сохраняет бэкап и:
On failure, the app keeps the backup and pending.json, blocks new writes and offers Continue. Resuming rechecks backup hashes, CID, firmware, current NV and config. Unknown states stop the operation for investigation. An uncertain EFS command result preserves recovery files and prevents further writes in the same session.

Restoring a saved pair uses a separate selected-backup action. It requires matching device and firmware, unchanged remaining 119 bytes in each NV record, and a fresh backup of the current state. Restoration uses the same checks, temporary config and reboots.

This operation does not flash raw partitions or ZTEDATA and does not remount /usr/zte_web. It changes NV550 and temporary EFS config; the Linux side receives temporary helpers and a lock. If access preparation is needed first, the agent, SSH and startup files listed in its help are also affected.

До установки скрипт проверяет точные хэш:
Before installation, the script verifies exact hashes, CID, available commands, directory types and permissions, write and execution access in /data, /etc and the relevant mounts, rc.local syntax, absence of another operation, and at least 16 MiB free in /data and 2 MiB in /etc.

The app creates its own mode-700 /data/zte-imei-studio directory under verified /data. Stock /data/local/tmp and /data/bin may have mode 777; installation does not require changing their permissions. Each installation receives a mode-700 directory inside the private directory with its own ownership marker.

Through adb push, it transfers zte-agent, dropbear, setup-agent.sh, start_zte_imei_studio.sh, id_ed25519.pub and the agent startup script. Each arrives under a unique incoming name with mode 600, is checked by SHA-256 and is then renamed. After hash and format verification, executable files receive mode 700 before their launch check. Remote shell exit status is checked separately from the local adb process exit code.

A new agent is installed as /data/zte-agent with startup at /data/zte-imei-studio/start_zte_agent.sh. Its configured password is stored as ZTE_AGENT_PASSWORD in this root-only mode-700 script. Normal preparation preserves a valid existing startup script and password; an inactive old agent is backed up and replaced by the current build. Forced preparation backs up the components before replacement, installs the current agent and applies the entered password. The agent listens on port 9090.

Dropbear and dropbearkey are placed in /data/zte-imei-studio/bin. The app public key is added to /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys while preserving other keys. Missing Ed25519/RSA server keys are generated.

The launcher /data/zte-imei-studio/start_zte_imei_studio.sh is added before the first exit 0 in /etc/rc.local, preserving existing lines. It starts the agent and SSH on port 2222 if absent; success requires a listener owned by the app on port 2222. New SSH access uses keys and disables password sign-in.
